selection_basis: Evidence of cross-vendor implementation and standard applicability, not a measured market-share ranking.
canonical_scope: ASVA engineering profiles are a project-defined interoperable superset, not certified native Redfish/BACnet/OPC UA schemas. Profile fields and poll intervals are engineering selections. Actual device support requires discovery and vendor documentation.

sources.title: DMTF DSP0268 Redfish Data Model Specification 2026.1
sources.use: Pinned resource vocabulary for IT, power distribution and liquid cooling; not a claim that installed devices implement all resources.

sources.title: DMTF Sensor JSON Schema
sources.use: Reading, ReadingUnits and ReadingTime normalization contract. Reader is a subset importer, not full service conformance validation.

sources.title: Dell iDRAC Redfish API
sources.use: First-party implementation evidence for server management.

sources.title: HPE server management getting started
sources.use: First-party Redfish implementation evidence across HPE compute platforms and PDUs.

sources.title: Vertiv Environet Alert FAQ
sources.use: First-party DCIM support for SNMP, Modbus TCP/IP and BACnet/IP, including third-party equipment.

sources.title: BACnet Committee FAQ
sources.use: Object/property interoperability, BTL/PICS discovery and distinction from Modbus register semantics.

sources.title: OPC 30030 BACnet information model, BACnetAnalogType
sources.use: Present_Value, units, reliability, status flags, out-of-service, priority semantics; object instances remain site-specific.

sources.title: IETF RFC 1628 UPS Management Information Base
sources.use: Exact UPS scalar OIDs, units/enumerations and output-line table indices.

sources.title: IETF RFC 3433 Entity Sensor MIB
sources.use: Sensor type, scale, precision, operational status and sysUpTime-based timestamps.

sources.title: Modbus Application Protocol Specification
sources.use: Register data model and FC03/04 read semantics. Device register offsets, word order and scale are vendor/site mappings.

sources.title: OPC UA Part 4 DataValue
sources.use: Value, quality StatusCode, source timestamp and server timestamp. No universal data-center NodeIds are asserted.

sources.title: Brick relationships
sources.use: Distinguish composition, location, feeds and points. Canonical graph relations are project terms, not a certified Brick graph.

sources.title: DOE/FEMP Best Practices Guide for Energy-Efficient Data Center Design
sources.use: Engineering equipment/power/cooling boundary context only; not a mandatory SCADA point list.

selected.name: Redfish
selected.role: Primary IT hardware resource model; supported facility power/cooling resources where implemented
selected.limitations: Discover service links, resource versions and OEM extensions; do not assume all devices implement all schemas.

selected.name: BACnet
selected.role: Primary building/HVAC object and property interface
selected.limitations: Object instance IDs and point-to-equipment meanings require PICS/discovery and commissioning.

selected.name: SNMP MIBs
selected.role: Existing UPS, PDU, network and sensor monitoring
selected.limitations: Use standard MIBs when exposed; enterprise MIBs remain vendor-specific. SNMPv3 is a deployment consideration, not implemented network transport here.

selected.name: Modbus
selected.role: Electrical meters, generator/PLC and HVAC register integration
selected.limitations: A transport/register specification, not a universal equipment semantic model; a supplied register map is mandatory.

selected.name: OPC UA
selected.role: SCADA interchange and typed quality/timestamp envelope
selected.limitations: Supplementary integration layer; no data-center adoption ranking or generic native device NodeSet is claimed.

selected.name: Brick
selected.limitations: No Brick RDF/SHACL conformance/export is claimed in this implementation.
